module purpose: neorv32_cpu_control is the CPU control unit: it accepts instructions from the fetch front end (frontend_i), decodes and sequences them in an execute state machine, drives the datapath control word, PC values and CSR accesses on ctrl_o, captures exceptions (lsu_err_i, pmp_fault_i, fetch faults, illegal instructions) and interrupts (irq_machine_i, irq_fast_i, irq_dbg_i), prioritizes them into a trap cause and redirects execution, and holds the privilege level, machine and debug CSRs, debug-mode and trigger state, returning CSR read data on csr_rdata_o.

use-case flows.value: acceptance of a fetched instruction from frontend_i into the instruction register, compressed flag and PC
instruction decode and execute sequencing: next state, registered control word, immediate, branch decision and next PC
exception capture, cause prioritization and trap entry into the machine handler or debug mode, saving cause, return address, trap value and privilege
interrupt request sampling, enable qualification and the interrupt-take decision
trap return (mret, dret) restoring PC, privilege and interrupt enable
CSR write of mstatus, mie, mtvec, mcounteren, mscratch, mepc, mcause, mcountinhibit, dcsr, dpc, dscratch0, tdata1 and tdata2 from csr.wdata at csr.addr
privilege and debug-mode checks that make CSR accesses and privileged instructions illegal, suppress the CSR write of an illegal instruction, and restrict trigger writes to debug mode
CSR value selected by csr.addr returned on csr_rdata_o
status and events driven on ctrl_o: effective and load/store privilege, sleep, trap entry, debug mode, counter events and inhibit
sleep entry on WFI and wake-up
debug entry requests and hardware trigger match
registers forced to constants while rstn_i is low: boot PC, machine mode, cleared CSRs, trap and debug state
